name: Sakura Swim Club
source: In Sakura Swim Club, follow the story of Kaede, just your average high school guy. Upon transferring to a new school, he meets two beautiful girls in the swim club. Things haven't gone well for the swim club lately, but with Kaede's help, that all changes.
translation: 在樱花游泳俱乐部中，跟随枫的故事，他只是一个普通的高中生。转学到新学校后，他在游泳俱乐部遇到了两个美丽的女孩。游泳俱乐部最近的情况不太顺利，但在枫的帮助下，一切都改变了。
